parsed.rationale: Both `MockHLSAVPlayer.play` and `MockPlayer.play` live under test-support paths (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/`) within the `Playback` package. Although the context flags report `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false`, the file paths and type names (both prefixed `Mock`) make clear these are test-double types. A `play` method with an empty signature is the minimal stub required by whatever player protocol each mock satisfies; the two mocks exist to stand in for structurally different collaborators (`HLSAVPlayer` vs a generic `Player`), so the coincidence of an identical no-op `play` body is structural only and does not represent actionable duplication. Consolidating them would couple unrelated test fixtures and risk breaking isolation.
